Rocket catch — training progress

The scale is percent of the golden pilot. 0% is the inert policy — a booster that does nothing at all. 100% is a hand-written PD controller flying the same held-out episodes, which catches roughly a third of them. The number underneath is live: the canonical score on the held-out exam bank, restricted to the stages currently being trained.

Why a percentage and not the raw score. When a stage unlocks the exam gets harder, so the arm's raw score drops — and so does the pilot's. Dividing by the pilot removes most of that artefact, so a harder test stops looking like a collapse. The unlock is still marked, because it did happen.

The pale line is one exam; the bold line is five. A single exam moves by more than a real generation of progress does, so read the bold line and ignore individual points.
